remarks: Welcome to 134 Standard Parkway, a charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath Cheektowaga home with character, a great location, and incredible potential. Set on a quiet street, this property offers a unique opportunity for a buyer looking to bring their vision to life and create something truly their own. Step in to the open living room featuring large windows that fill the space with natural light, while the original hardwood floors add warmth and timeless character. The efficient galley-style kitchen offers a practical layout for everyday living and entertaining, with an opportunity to update and personalize the space to your needs. The full basement includes partially finished space that could become a recreation room, home office, hobby area, or additional storage. Above, the large walk-up attic offers an impressive amount of space and a true blank canvas, with potential for additional bedrooms, a private primary suite, bonus living space, storage, and more. Outside, the immaculate 2-car garage is a standout feature, complete with electric and a large loft offering abundant room for storage, hobbies, projects, or sports equipment. The partially fenced yard provides additional outdoor space to enjoy. The location makes this property especially appealing for those who want to enjoy all that Buffalo has to offer. You'll be approximately 15 minutes from the new Bills stadium and just 10 minutes from KeyBank Center and downtown Buffalo, with shopping, dining, parks, entertainment, and major roadways all conveniently nearby. This is a home with a story to tell and plenty of room for a new one to begin. Whether you're looking to renovate, create your dream home, or unlock the potential of a property in a convenient location, 134 Standard Parkway is ready for its next chapter! Offers being reviewed as they come in. Seller reserves right to set a deadline.
